title: Exact approval tab readiness
summary: Linux browser approval waits for the current request's exact URL or its same-origin exact-code organization route before pressing Approve machine. An older tab on the same origin does not establish readiness. The bounded wait uses the shared canonical matcher, and still revalidates the tab before pressing. If the exact tab never appears, machine_browser_tab_missing tells the operator to check the installer's browser profile and rerun with a fresh request. Host preparation refusals are preserved rather than retried as a missing tab.
